messages:
carmen_sales: Heads-up: EuroMedTech asked for SIG/CAIQ responses plus a DSAR + deletion attestation for POC telemetry. They specifically want proof of deletion that is tamper-evident (ledger/hash) in addition to purge logs. Deadline: Fri COB CET.

zia_security: Interesting ask. We usually provide purge-job logs, S3 delete markers, and an attestation signed by Legal. We can also provide KMS key-rotation records. Ledger/hash proof is non-standard for POC but we can generate a hash manifest of deleted object ids and sign it in our audit ledger. Need infra help.

matt_privacy: From GDPR standpoint, the attestation + purge logs + export manifest should be enough. But if they want additional tamper-evidence, a SHA256 manifest of deleted object IDs plus a signed timestamp (legal sign-off) is acceptable. We should be clear about controller vs processor and subprocessors.

igor_infra: We can produce the following artifacts for each telemetry type: 1) purge job run log (stdout + exit code), 2) S3 delete marker example, 3) DB tombstone row with deletion timestamp, 4) signed deletion manifest (sha256 of object keys) written to audit-ledger (append-only). We can pin POC to eu-west-1 and enforce VPC endpoints.

carmen_sales: Can you create a one-row-per-telemetry CSV they can paste into their vendor spreadsheet with a column listing the deletion artifacts we will provide? Keep it short.

zia_security: Quick CSV below, compact labels. I'll include CAIQ control refs.

```
telemetry,storage,region,encryption,access,retention_days,deletion_artifacts,caiq_ref
request_logs,S3:project-logs,eu-west-1,KMS,rbac+audit,21,purge-log;s3-delete-marker;ledger-hash,SC-8
metrics,TSDB:prod,eu-west-1,disk-enc,svc-roles,90,retention-policy-log,CM-2
embeddings,enc-db,eu-west-1,KMS,restricted-acl,60,db-tombstone;purge-log;ledger-hash,DP-3
prompts(debug-only),ephemeral,eu-west-1,KMS,limited,7,cron-purge-log;blob-delete;ledger-hash,AP-4
kv-snapshots,ephemeral,eu-west-1,NA,devops-only,0,delete-note;ledger-hash,aud-1
```

zia_security: Note: "ledger-hash" = sha256 manifest of deleted object keys written to our append-only audit ledger and signed by legal. We'll attach a sample signed-manifest.

matt_privacy: DPA clause for paste: "Redwood will not use POC customer telemetry, prompts, or embeddings for model training or improvement without explicit written opt-in from the customer. Retention and deletion will follow the POC onboarding configuration and the DSAR runbook provided."

legal-bot: TEMPLATE: attach poc_trial_dpa_addendum_v4 and subprocessors_declaration_v3. For ledger-hash attestation, route to legal-ops with ticket DSAR-180555. Legal can sign sample manifest.

ops-bot: Created ticket DSAR-180555. Workflow owner: privacy-ops.

igor_infra: I'll prepare a sanitized sample: `signed_manifest_sha256.txt`, `purge_job_2026-03-01.log`, and `s3_delete_marker_example.txt`. Will pin region and enforce VPC endpoints for this customer.

zia_security: I'll draft CAIQ excerpts referencing SC-8 / DP-3 / CM-2 and include a short note: "POC-specific debug logging may be enabled; debug logs are annotated and scheduled for immediate purge post-debug."

carmen_sales: Scheduling: MedTech wants a 30-min walkthrough Thu 11:00 CET or Fri 09:00 CET. I'll send invite for Thu 11:00 CET. Please confirm attendees.

igor_infra: I can do Thu 11:00 CET.

matt_privacy: I'll join and bring the DSAR runbook + DPA clause.

zia_security: I'll join and bring CAIQ + CSV mapping + sample signed manifest.

carmen_sales: Great — sending invite now and will attach the CSV and DPA sentence. Tagging legal for attestation prep. :thumbsup:

(edited)
